import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
acc = df[df.account_id=='YxSxqn0'].copy()
acc['dt'] = pd.to_datetime(acc.date, format='%m/%d/%y')

# Compare 10/13 vs baseline (median of other days) at each level
def compare(cols, date='2025-10-13'):
    sub = acc[acc.dt != date]
    base = sub.groupby(cols).unblended_cost.median()
    day = acc[acc.dt==date].groupby(cols).unblended_cost.sum()
    out = pd.concat([day, base], axis=1).rename(columns={'unblended_cost':'day','unblended_cost':'base'})
    out['diff'] = out.day - out.base
    return out.sort_values('diff', ascending=False)

for cols in [['csp'],['csp','cloud_service'],['csp','cloud_service','application']]:
    print('---', cols)
    print(compare(cols).head(15))
